units.name: Department of Information Systems, Analytics, and Supply Chain
units.evidence: The official departmental page explicitly gives this full name and business college parent. Its Supply Chain Management BS page explicitly teaches operations, procurement and sourcing, transportation, global SCM, logistics, ERP and operations excellence.

decisions.reason: The imported college and department names match the official current department and parent exactly.

limitations: This source-bounded check includes the current business department and engineering organizational list. It does not enumerate all individual interdisciplinary engineering research projects or infer a formal historic rename from old news tags.
